output.answer_markdown: Nucor says EPD legislation has already caused it to incur additional costs [1]. The federal government and numerous states are considering requiring EPDs to evaluate the environmental impacts of products [2]. Nucor also states that EPD legislation has the potential to put domestic steel manufacturers at a disadvantage to foreign competitors unless standardized mechanisms are used to fully evaluate products produced by foreign steel producers [1].

provenance.quote: EPD legislation has caused Nucor to incur additional costs and has the potential to put domestic steel manufacturers at a disadvantage to foreign competitors unless standardized mechanisms are used to fully evaluate products produced by foreign steel producers.

claims.text: EPD legislation has caused Nucor to incur additional costs and has the potential to put domestic steel manufacturers at a disadvantage to foreign competitors.

provenance.quote: The federal government and numerous states are considering establishing requirements for Environmental Product Declarations (“EPDs”) to evaluate environmental impacts of products.
